issues.evidence: 'Your files, stored on your device.' next to 'Cloud AI may process document content.'
issues.suggested_action: Add one line on which model/provider and what controls (no training, region, enterprise key) or say 'bring your own model'; lawyers stop here otherwise

issues.evidence: 'Not another chatbot. Your workspace.' shows a new Office-like app; nothing says whether my .docx/.xlsx/.pptx open back in Microsoft Office, SharePoint or with the firm template intact
issues.suggested_action: Show the edited deck/model opening in real PowerPoint/Excel with tracked changes preserved, or a super 'Plain .docx .xlsx .pptx in and out'

issues.evidence: The broken-formatting pain (Template gone / Numbering wrong) is never visibly fixed; the memo is only shown cropped (f_31)
issues.suggested_action: One shot of the full memo page after the edit with formatting intact

issues.evidence: Stock actress with head in hands twice (f_10, f_13) plus head-drop on desk; in a lit open office with colleagues in background
issues.suggested_action: Keep one reaction; replace the other with a quieter real detail (hand hovering, re-checking a cell)

issues.evidence: 'All changes reviewed 10 of 10' arrives after 'Accept all'; as a reviewer I want to know I actually looked at each, not bulk-accepted
issues.suggested_action: Show one change opened as a diff before Accept all, e.g. tap Slide 4 title to see the slide side-by-side

issues.evidence: 'Request early access' with no price, platform or pilot offer
issues.suggested_action: Add 'Mac · Windows' and 'Pilot with your own board pack' under the button

purchase_objections: Cloud AI processes my client documents: where, which model, retention, training?
Do I have to leave Microsoft Office / SharePoint, and do files round-trip with firm templates intact?
Does it work on messy real models with linked ranges and named cells, not a 5-row demo sheet?
The opening pain (wrecked formatting) is never shown solved
Early access only: no pricing, no security certifications, no firm references
would_try: maybe: the €74.6m-in-three-files story and 'Slide 4 caught' is exactly my bad morning, and the honest labels ('Can make mistakes', 'real recording, sped up') earn some trust, but I would only trial it on non-client files until I know where the content goes.
buy_decision: TRY_FIRST: flips to BUY if I see it run on my own firm-template board pack, round-trip cleanly to native Office files, with a clear no-training/data-residency guarantee for client documents.
top_revision: Add one beat showing the edited memo/deck opening in native Word/PowerPoint with the firm template and tracked changes intact, which answers both the 'formatting wrecked' setup and the switching-cost objection.
